Message:
drm/amd/gfx: add instance field to select_se_sh (v3)

Add ability to specify instance in select_se_sh callback.
Defaults to 0xffffffff all over the driver.

(v2) Don't enable INSTANCE_BROADCAST by default
(v3) Style changes
